articles.title: AARO Releases FY2025 UAP Report Months After Statutory Deadline, Citing 319 New Cases and Expanded Satellite Analysis
articles.summary: The Department of Defense’s All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) has released its Fiscal Year 2025 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena, documenting 319 newly received UAP reports while emphasizing that every resolved case was ultimately attributed to conventional causes. articles.title: GEIPAN: 法国官方 UFO 调查机构公开案件数据库
articles.summary: GEIPAN 是法国国家空间研究中心（CNES）下属的官方 UAP 调查机构，自 1977 年以来持续运行，拥有全球最完整的官方 UFO 调查档案。
